mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ecu ( id, project_id, name, ecu_type, description, mac, ip, port, ecu_index ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{desc}, #{mac}, #{ip}, #{port}, #{index} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ecu SET name = #{name}, ecu_type = #{type}, description = #{desc}, mac = #{mac}, ip = #{ip}, port = #{port}, ecu_index = #{index}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
